items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And Basie and I, as I say we've been friends -- I met him around 1937... So we've been friends ever since.

ctx.x:
You know, it's just amazing. Well, okay.
So any way, I've had the good fortune to have played with the giants, despite being, you know, ignored by the critics I was there, you know. And Basie and I, as I say we've been friends -- I met him around 1937, whenever they came to the Grand Terrace I met him. So we've been friends ever since.
On his first trip to New York?
